# Cleanote

Cleanote converts handwritten notes, worksheets, equations, and study pages into editable, searchable text.

## Important pages

- Homepage: https://www.cleanote.in/
- Handwriting to text: https://www.cleanote.in/handwriting-to-text/
- Homework scanner: https://www.cleanote.in/homework-scanner/
- Web scanner: https://www.cleanote.in/app/
- Support: https://www.cleanote.in/support/
- Privacy: https://www.cleanote.in/privacy/

## Product notes

Cleanote is a product of Karigari Home LLC. It is designed for students, parents, researchers, and professionals who need to capture handwritten or annotated paper material and review converted text before using it.
